Q: How to auto approve renovate merge requests in gitlab? A:

Auto Approve Only

If you just want to enable automatic approval, then you need to do the following:

  • Set autoApprove to true in the renovate's global config (config.js):
...
autoApprove: true,
...
  • Make sure that the GitLab user for renovate has the right permissions (correct scopes) on its personal access token and correct role assigned (Developer atleast) to it on the group level or each repository level so it has the permission to approve the MR.
  • You need to make sure the following settings are disabled (unchecked) on the group level and repository level:
    • [ ] Prevent approval by merge request creator
    • [ ] Prevent approvals by users who add commits

Both Auto Approve and Auto Merge

If you're interested in enabling both automatic approval and automatic merging, your renovate's global config (config.js) should look as follows:

...
autoApprove: true,
automerge: true,
automergeType: "pr",
automergeStrategy: "auto",
gitLabIgnoreApprovals: false,
platformAutomerge: true,
...

Also, check the rules under protected branches section to make sure it has the permissions to merge. You might have to add the renovate bot user merge permission separately in each repository.
